svg.title: gdfaler / Contribution Array
svg.desc: GitHub GraphQL contribution calendar. An isometric column chart, one position per day. Weeks run left to right and weekday rows run frontward, Sunday to Saturday. Zero days are flat outlined markers. Nonzero column height is logarithmic in the real count; top-face color follows the five GitHub activity levels. No decorative terrain or simulated data.
svg.text: Height: 9 + 11 × log₂(n + 1), uniformly scaled to fit / color: GitHub levels
